header: Plays the TEST notes on a panel event: PanelGroupQueue_Append calls it (T_F434D4) on variant 2 for group 2 when W bit 3 is set, passing WA. header: MIDI-out housekeeping MainTask_Loop runs beside T_Blink_Tick: every 150 Tick_Count ticks (~0.31 s at 488 Hz) drops both ports' running-status mailboxes (0x9B port A, 0x091F port B) so the next message resends its status; every 1500 ticks (~3.1 s) re-reads P8 bit 2 into (0x0922) bit 0 (inverted) and queues {0x10A8, value} via Queue2E00_AppendRegs when it changed. Basis: caller + body.
